mechanical_set_proof.explanation_of_1078_vs_1099: 1099 is the mathematically verified unique P0-P4 local primary count. 1078 was a prior arithmetic error resulting from double-subtracting the 21 external shared nodes that were already included in the 114 shared set (1213 - 114 - 21 = 1078 was invalid double-subtraction; the valid equation is 1213 - 93 - 21 = 1099).
